mit-hasts-phd.en: The interdisciplinary HASTS program studies the social, cultural, and political life of science and technology through history, anthropology, and science and technology studies.

mit-linguistics-phd.en: The doctoral curriculum develops research in generative linguistics, with a focus on formal models of human language.

mit-materials-science-and-engineering-ph.en: Research areas include biomedical, electronic, photonic, structural, and polymeric materials, as well as computational materials science.

mit-materials-science-and-engineering-sc.en: Research areas include biomedical, electronic, photonic, structural, and polymeric materials, as well as computational materials science.

mit-meche-phd-course-2.en: Research areas include mechanics, design and manufacturing, energy, fluid dynamics, robotics, biomaterials, and ocean engineering.

mit-microbiology-phd.en: Research areas include microbial genetics and physiology, host–microbe interactions, virology, microbial ecology, and computational microbiology.

mit-sloan-management-phd.en: Research fields include accounting, finance, marketing, organization studies, system dynamics, and technological innovation.

mit-mit-whoi-phd.en: Research areas span biological, chemical, and physical oceanography, marine geology and geophysics, and applied ocean science and engineering.
